comments.author: rpmwpm
comments.body_html: The description is in the original mod page (here’s the link), but the tl;dr is it repairs equipment over time. You can set the repair amount and intervals for weapons and armor separately so it can be as OP or unobtrusive as you want. It’s configurable under the F12 menu (just press the f12 key once you’ve loaded the game).
